Third-party source files bundled with the native Windows edition.

- miniz 3.1.2: ZIP/Deflate support. Source: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/3.1.2. See third_party/miniz/LICENSE.
- nlohmann/json 3.12.0: JSON serialization and parsing. Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0 (MIT License).

Both libraries are compiled into the application. End users do not need to install them.
